meta.source: tools/embed.py on data/raw via tools/build_db.py loaders; fights dated 2026-01-01 or later are dropped on load (hidden-data protocol)
meta.refits: quarterly full refits 2010-01-01..2025-10-01 (warm-started, Procrustes-chained), a light fighter-only Newton update after every event, final refit 2026-01-01 (roster)
meta.orientation: axes rotated to varimax of the 2019-01-01 refit's loadings, offense axes signed so the largest loading is positive, defense axes so that positive = opponents do less of the dominant task; each axis scaled to unit sd over fighters with a decayed fight count >= 1 at 2019-01-01 and ordered by its effect on predictions
meta.embedding_layout: [o0..o7, d0..d7]; xA / xB = decayed fight count (half-life 730 days) behind the embedding (0 = no UFC stat fight: the vector is the division-average zero)
meta.corner: A / B as in backtest_dev.json (A = first-named); nothing in the model uses the order

offense.label: distance head-strike volume (striker, not a submitter)
finishing striker: accuracy and KO power
efficient close-range and leg striking (weak axis)

defense.label: anti-grappling: hard to take down, hold or submit
denies distance striking (fights end up on the mat; more reversals against)
hard to hit clean or finish
keeps fights out of the clinch (eats more leg kicks)
denies body and leg kicks (weak axis)

mlrates_blend.keep_rule: b2 kept where time-ordered expanding-window CV inside 2019-2023 (fit on years < y, score y = 2020..2023) lowers deviance; 'recipe' is that CV-selected recipe (exported), 'recipe_all_targets' keeps b2 everywhere (reference only)

integration.selection_rule: variant (base, +emb, +emb_x) with the lowest time-ordered expanding-window CV log loss inside 2019-2023 (fit on years < y, score y = 2020..2023); chosen - base = 0 where base wins. segments report +emb - base for every set as a diagnostic, chosen or not.

leak_check.note: relative to the defender-only predictor (attacker vector zero); pre = exported snapshot, post = the attacker's vector at his next fight (has seen this fight)

neighbours_v2.pool: decayed fight count >= 2.0 at 2026-01-01, a fight in 2023-2025, men

views.profile_distance: Euclidean distance on the 42-effect standardised profile (style + quality)
views.style_cosine_quality_out: cosine after removing the profile direction of the linear win head
views.attempts_cosine: cosine on the offense attempt effects only: d_att, c_att, g_att, h_att, b_att, l_att, ns_att, td_att, ctrl, sub_att
views.profile_distance_145_170: profile distance within Featherweight / Lightweight / Welterweight
